description.value: Kam Do Bakery is a well-regarded Chinese bakery in Richmond known for its generous, honestly filled pastries and buns — from egg tarts and pineapple pastries with salted egg yolk to savory chicken and sausage buns. With over 1,200 reviews and a loyal local following, it sits steps from a busy mall and transit stop, making it a convenient mid-ride snack stop. All items are individually wrapped, easy to carry, and suited to eating on the go.
